$comment: Perdition, the Frontier town. Single source of truth for server collision, the client scene and the minimap. Units are metres; x runs east, z runs south, origin at the north-west corner. Rects are {x, z} min corner plus {w, d} size, on the 0.5 m collision grid. Low cover blocks movement and bullets but not sight; vaultHeight (m) marks low cover a rider can vault; top (m) is what a rider can stand on. Buildings carry their roof shape, second floors and stairs. Generated by tools/perdition-layout.ts (edit the plan there); tools/town-audit.ts lists the checks it must pass.
name: Perdition
